title: Manyhands JSON v1 repair mutation data
description: The data of a document repair or ticket repair envelope. It may accompany any outcome: a success, a no-op, a partial result, and a rejection that is about the item. A request whose source names no item carries none. It never holds the corrected source or anything the nonconforming file held.

id.description: The ID the corrected source carries.

path.description: The file the request corrects, relative to the item's context, with forward slashes: the path it has on the primary branch too.

adopted.description: Whether the ID was assigned to a file that held no valid one. False for a file that held this ID already. Null when the request stopped before the file was read.
